wire.t: MakeItRains paid $49 of FAAB for David Montgomery, two days after Pudge247 dropped him to pick up Roschon Johnson. One man's trash is another man's $49 RB.
FatMikeR has opened the app. Five free-agent moves in a week, including Terry McLaurin, Cooper Kupp, Ryan Flournoy and Jordan Watkins. Bijan is your daddy is officially alive.
Br0phy put J.J. McCarthy on the trade block. Wild Goose Chase still has more quarterbacks than good decisions at quarterback.
Pudge247 made four free-agent moves in two days, adding and dropping Dontayvion Wicks inside 24 hours before landing on Jaylin Noel and Ted Hurst III. ChuckJ10's review: "Tinker tinker."
ChuckJ10 claimed Tyler Higbee for $1 and Samaje Perine for $3, and admitted in chat he "prob should have started Rhamondre." Nothing to see here, as advertised.
Jalen Hurts is expected to miss the rest of the season with blood clots in his lungs. Stroud of Turin already cut him, which, for once, was the right call.
Davante Adams ruptured his hamstring and is out 6-10 weeks. The defending champ just lost his best receiver.
Saquon Barkley (hamstring) is back at practice and on track for Monday night against Dallas. MY DAD IS DEAD has him in the lineup.
Lamar Jackson (ankle) has missed two games and is a game-time call vs. Cincinnati. With Josh Allen on bye, Ivefallenandicantgetup needs him.

stories.title: Defending champ is 1-5, broke, and down to his last healthy receiver
stories.dek: OneSillyBannana won the whole thing in 2025. Six weeks into his title defense, he's lost four straight, spent every FAAB dollar, and watched Davante Adams rupture a hamstring.
body: Ten months ago OneSillyBannana was holding the Addicks trophy after taking down MakeItRains in the final. Today MY DAD IS DEAD is 1-5 with the second-worst points total in the league and the worst all-play record of anybody (17-49). If you played every team every week, he'd beat roughly one a week.

The money is gone too. He spent all $200 of his FAAB budget, including $80 on T.J. Hockenson in Week 4. Hockenson gave him 1.7 points in his first start back and is now in the concussion protocol. He's starting him again this week.

Then the injuries. Saquon Barkley's hamstring has turned his season into 23 points over four starts, and Davante Adams just ruptured his hamstring and is out 6-10 weeks. Saquon is expected back Monday night against Dallas, which might be the only good news this franchise has gotten since the parade.
Week 7 he gets Breece'sBurdenDeflowered, the luckiest 4-2 team in the league. If there's a game on the board for him, it's this one.

stories.title: Achane in the Membrane is 1-5 and it's not his fault. It's God's.
stories.dek: MakeItRains has more points than five teams and the most points scored against him in the league. Give him Breece'sBurdenDeflowered's schedule and he's 5-1.
body: Last year MakeItRains made the championship game. This year he's lost three games while scoring 130-plus, including a 148.32 in Week 5 that ran straight into Wild Goose Chase's season-high 191.06. Nobody in the league has had more points dropped on them (824.16).

Run his real scores against Breece'sBurdenDeflowered's schedule and he's 5-1 and in first place. His all-play record is 32-34, basically a .500 team stuck at 1-5. Patrick Mahomes being the QB16 coming off ACL surgery isn't helping, but this one's mostly the schedule.
Week 7 he draws Ivefallenandicantgetup without Josh Allen, who's on bye. That's about as soft as Ivefallenandicantgetup gets. If the curse is real, Lamar comes off the injury report and drops 35.

stories.title: rtmcruise is 4-2 again. History says it ends in tears.
stories.dek: Three championship games, three losses. Now he's winning with the softest schedule in the league and no FAAB left.
body: rtmcruise has lost the Addicks final three times: 2020, 2022 and 2024. Nobody else has more than one runner-up finish. That's a man who knows how to get to the big game and has no idea what to do once he's there.

This year's 4-2 looks a lot like a setup. Breece'sBurdenDeflowered has the fewest points against in the league (628.38) and a 26-40 all-play record, ninth-best. He spent $100 on Kalif Raymond in Week 3, has never started him, and was out of money by Week 4. Now Mike Evans is hurt and there's no budget to replace him.
He gets the 1-5 defending champ in Week 7. If he wins, it's luck. If he loses, it's tradition.

stories.title: dstafford owns three rings and the WR1. Be afraid.
stories.dek: The only three-peat in league history is 4-2 with Jaxon Smith-Njigba putting up numbers that don't look real.
body: dstafford4254 won the Addicks in 2021, 2022 and 2023. Nobody else has more than one. He's been quiet for two years, and NjigbaR Please! looks like the team that ends that.

JSN has 164.9 points, 34 more than any other receiver, including a 43.5 in Week 2. Tyler Shough is the QB5 off the waiver wire. He also lit $125 of FAAB on fire for Mike Washington Jr., who has never started a game for him, so he's not perfect. He's just good enough.
Week 7 is Lead Nagger, the hottest team in the league. Line's a pick'em.

feature.title: Week 6: The newsletter guy finally shows up
body: Lawrence of a Labia put up 140.54, the top score of the week, and handed NjigbaR Please! its second loss. Christian McCaffrey had 30.7 and Trevor Lawrence added 27.3. It's the first time all year Bill_Buttlicker's team has looked like it deserved its record. Enjoy it. The all-play says 27-39.

The closest game of the season went to Breece'sBurdenDeflowered, 96.38 to 94.70 over Nothing to see here. Neither team cracked 100. ChuckJ10 now owns the season low, the biggest blowout loss, and the closest loss, a full set of misery in six weeks.

Llamageddon lost by 8.04 to Wild Goose Chase with Tre Tucker's 27.7 on the bench and Juwan Johnson's zero in the flex. Johnson played and just didn't catch anything. That's the sixth week in a row dcrabb has left a 20-pointer on the pine, and why a top-five roster is 2-4.

Bijan is your daddy started two zeros and lost to Achane in the Membrane by 11. One was bad luck (Bateman's shoulder). The other was Cam Skattebo, who the Giants benched and gave zero touches. Not every zero is a lineup mistake, but a $0 FAAB budget isn't helping anybody.

rankings.take: Most points in the league and the 191 bomb. Would be 5-1 if he'd started Drake Maye in Week 4.
Rookie owner, second-best team. Josh Allen's bye means the Lamar insurance finally matters, if his ankle holds.
Three rings and the WR1. Lost to the newsletter guy in Week 6, which should be a fireable offense.
Three straight wins, Isaiah Likely is the TE1, and the 2024 champ looks like himself again.
Top-five roster, bottom-four record. Leaves 23 points a week on the bench.
Average team, extraordinary quarterback drama. Got Stroud back. Cut Hurts the right way.
Last year's runner-up and the unluckiest man alive. Light a candle.
Top score in Week 6 earns a one-spot bump. Still 10th in points. Still writes the newsletter.
Softest schedule in the league, no FAAB, and Mike Evans just hurt his Achilles.
Rookie owner hasn't spent a dollar on waivers. Got burned by two zeros in Week 6.
Last year's top seed. This year: season low, worst blowout, closest loss. A complete set.
Defending champ. Four straight losses, $0 FAAB, Adams out 6-10 weeks.

teams.name: Wild Goose Chase
teams.w7: vs. Lawrence of a Labia · favored by 29
body: Br0phy went 5-9 as Skatt Men in his first season. Year two, he has the most points in the league (834.58), the season high (191.06), and the best all-play record (46-20). Christian Watson is the WR3. Drake Maye is the QB2. This is the best team in the league.

His one problem is that he picked the wrong quarterback in Week 4 and lost by 2.64 with Maye's 26.16 on the bench. He's also carrying Bryce Young and J.J. McCarthy, so he's hoarding QBs in a one-QB league. Ja'Marr Chase is the WR18, but this roster wins anyway.

teams.name: Ivefallenandicantgetup
teams.w7: vs. Achane in the Membrane · favored by 4.5
body: krunkdd took over this seat this year and has the second-best team in the league. Josh Allen is the QB1, and he spent most of September with Lamar Jackson riding his bench as the most expensive backup in the league.

This week that pays off, maybe. Allen's on bye and Lamar's ankle has cost him two games. If Lamar plays, it was genius. If not, he's starting whatever's left against the most cursed team in fantasy football.

teams.name: NjigbaR Please!
body: The only three-time champion in Addicks history (2021, 2022, 2023). He's 4-2 with JSN as the runaway WR1 at 164.9 points.

He's not flawless. $125 on Mike Washington Jr. in Week 1, never started. Tyler Shough scored -0.16 in Week 5 and he still won that week, because of course he did. Losing to the newsletter guy in Week 6 was the low point of his season.

teams.name: Lead Nagger
body: Pudge247 won it all in 2024, went 5-9 last year, and is back on a three-game heater. Isaiah Likely is somehow the TE1 and Kenneth Walker III is the RB2.
He sat Sam Darnold's 27.66 in Week 3 and lost by 7.82, It's working anyway. Week 7 against the dynasty is the game of the week.

teams.name: Llamageddon
teams.w7: vs. Bijan is your daddy · favored by 14.5
body: dcrabb has the second-highest max points in the league (903.06) and has left 138.4 points on his bench, the most of anybody. He has Purdy and Goff and keeps guessing wrong between them. He had Tre Tucker (27.7) on the bench and Juwan Johnson (0.0) in the flex in a Week 6 loss by 8.
Seven seasons, zero finals. The roster can win this league. The guy setting the lineup has to let it.

teams.name: Stroud of Turin
teams.w7: vs. Nothing to see here · favored by 16.5
body: RedDevil904 named his 2022 team Circle-Jerk Kirk, so the Cousins thing isn't new. In Week 3 he dropped C.J. Stroud for Kirk Cousins. Then he traded Cousins and Jaylen Waddle to Achane in the Membrane to get Stroud back. Same QB, one less receiver, and the team's literally named after him.

To be fair, cutting Jalen Hurts was the right call. Hurts is expected to miss the rest of the season with blood clots in his lungs. He also spent $190 of FAAB, the third-most in the league, chasing receivers.

teams.name: Achane in the Membrane
past: Gibbs Your Balls A Tug (2025 runner-up)
body: Last year's runner-up has the most points against in the league and three losses with 130-plus. Swap in Breece'sBurdenDeflowered's schedule and he's 5-1. Mahomes is the QB16 coming off ACL surgery, but Gibbs is the RB1 overall. The roster isn't the problem.
He just traded for Kirk Cousins and Jaylen Waddle. At 1-5 in a keeper league, he's at a fork: chase it, or sell Gibbs and set up 2027.

teams.name: Lawrence of a Labia
body: Most regular-season wins in league history (61) and zero titles. Lost the 2019 final, went 12-2 in 2021 and lost in the semis, finished third last year. The newsletter guy is the league's most decorated loser.

This year he's 4-2 with the 10th-most points, the luckiest team in the league by a mile. DJ Moore has 37 points in five starts with a bad shoulder. Week 7 he's starting Jacoby Brissett against the best team in the league as a 29-point underdog. Should be fun.

teams.name: Breece'sBurdenDeflowered
teams.w7: vs. MY DAD IS DEAD · favored by 11
inj: Mike Evans (Achilles), expected to miss time
body: Three final appearances, three losses. The league's eternal bridesmaid is 4-2 behind the fewest points against in the league.

He spent $100 on Kalif Raymond and $61 on Braelon Allen and was broke by Week 4. Now Mike Evans is hurt, Breece Hall is questionable, and there's no money to fix either one. He gets the 1-5 defending champ this week.

teams.name: Bijan is your daddy
body: FatMikeR is new this year and hasn't spent a dollar of FAAB. He's sitting on $200 while everyone else is broke. That's either a genius plan for the playoff push or he forgot the app has a waiver tab.

Week 6 he started Cam Skattebo, who the Giants benched with zero touches, and Rashod Bateman, who hurt his shoulder. Two zeros, lost by 11. Now Deebo's hamstring is out too. Time to spend some money, FatMikeR.

teams.name: Nothing to see here
body: ChuckJ10 won the very first Addicks in 2019 and was last year's top seed at 11-3 before losing in the semis. This year he has the fewest points in the league, the season low (63.02), the biggest blowout loss (81.04), and the closest loss (1.68).
Justin Jefferson and Malik Nabers are on this roster. Caleb Williams is the QB19. ChuckJ10 should be the most aggressive trader in the league right now and instead he's dead quiet.

teams.name: MY DAD IS DEAD
body: The defending champion. Went 12-2 in 2024, won it all in 2025, and is now 1-5 with the worst all-play record in the league.

He blew all $200 of FAAB, including $80 on Hockenson in Week 4, a guy he'd added and cut in Week 1. Adams is out 6-10 weeks, Saquon has 23 points in four starts, and two of his starters are in the concussion protocol. The title defense is over. Selling Chris Olave for 2027 is the move.

rumors.t: RedDevil904 has drafted paperwork to rename his team 'Cousins of Turin,' deleted it, re-drafted it, and traded it back to himself.
The league office is looking into whether OneSillyBannana's FAAB was spent by a toddler holding his phone.
Br0phy has been texting Drake Maye 'sorry about Week 4' every night at 2am. Maye has not responded.
FatMikeR made five roster moves this week. The league office has asked him to confirm it was actually him and not a burglar who knows his phone passcode.
MakeItRains paid $49 for the David Montgomery that Pudge247 threw in the trash two days earlier. Pudge247 is reportedly now billing him for storage.
rtmcruise has started practicing his runner-up speech. He's had a lot of practice.
Pudge247 has added and dropped so many wide receivers this week that Sleeper assigned him a personal account manager. Dontayvion Wicks lasted one day.
Pudge247 wants a Brian Thomas Jr. trade so badly that sources say he's been leaving BTJ fan mail under Bill_Buttlicker's windshield wipers. Lawrence of a Labia has not responded.

trades.why: After this week, once Josh Allen's back from bye. Lamar is a luxury backup on Ivefallenandicantgetup and ChuckJ10 is starting the QB19. krunkdd turns a bench QB into a WR1, ChuckJ10 gets a QB who can actually win him a week.
dcrabb has receivers to burn and his second RB slot keeps putting up single-digit weeks. Bill_Buttlicker has four running backs and a DJ Moore with a bad shoulder.
Achane in the Membrane is 1-5 with one superstar and no depth. Two weekly starters for the RB1 fixes two lineup holes at once, and Pudge247 gets the best back in football for his playoff run.

Br0phy is stacked at RB and could use another WR1 with Ja'Marr Chase underperforming. The defending champ has Adams out 6-10 weeks and Saquon still working back, so he needs a healthy back more than a third receiver.
ChuckJ10 sends both of his WR1s for a running back the Giants just benched with zero touches. He's seen the film. He thinks Skattebo is 'due.'
krunkdd decides Allen's bye week proved he's replaceable and takes Bill_Buttlicker's backup QB and a WR3 for the QB1 overall. The newsletter guy accepts in four seconds.
RedDevil904 trades Stroud for Cousins. Again. The third time these two have swapped places this season. At this point it's not a trade, it's a custody arrangement.

trying: He opened the app. Five free-agent moves in a week. FatMikeR stays on this list until one of them actually scores.
Season low, worst blowout, closest loss, lowest points. Last year's top seed is speedrunning last place.
Yes, the newsletter guy. 4-2 with 10th-most points, starting Brissett this week as a 29-point dog.
gfy: Dropped Stroud for Cousins, then traded two guys to get Stroud back. It's in your team name.
4-2 with the softest schedule in the league and $100 on a guy he's never started. Enjoy it while it lasts.
Benched Drake Maye for Bryce Young and lost by 2.64. Best team in the league, should be 5-1.

Bill_Buttlicker's starting Brissett with Lawrence on bye and Monangai's toe. The house thanks him for his business.
Lowest total on the board. Saquon's Monday night return is the only reason to stay up.

columnists.name: Barry "The Mouth" McCockiner
columnists.bio: Has never once lowered his voice. Writes from the press box, where he's been asked to leave twice. Believes every 4-2 team is either a dynasty or a disgrace.

columnists.name: Dick Fitzwell
columnists.bio: Former college linebacker who still talks like he's in the film room. Blunt, loud, and always one sentence away from calling you soft.

columnists.name: Oliver Klozoff
columnists.bio: Finished 14th in a 12-team league once. Nobody knows how. Files his columns from a lawn chair and gives advice anyway.

columnists.name: Connie Lingus
columnists.bio: Has a spreadsheet for everything. None of her spreadsheets are correct, and she will defend every one of them.

columns.title: BREECE IS A FRAUD AND I WILL NOT BE SILENCED
columns.dek: Four wins. FOUR. And not one of them would survive a stiff breeze.
body: Let me tell you something, and I want everybody at home to hear me. rtmcruise is 4-2 and he has NO BUSINESS being 4-2. NONE. His all-play record is 26-40. That's ninth in this league! You play everybody every week, he's a below-.500 football team, and he's out here strutting like he invented the forward pass!

He's had the softest schedule in the league. 628 points against! That's not a schedule, that's a spa day! That's a hot stone massage with cucumber water on the side! Meanwhile Achane in the Membrane is getting mugged every single week and this man is getting his feet rubbed!

And don't you DARE tell me about his roster. He spent ONE HUNDRED DOLLARS on Kalif Raymond. One hundred! Has he started him? NO! Not once! That's not a waiver claim, that's a hostage situation! Then he's broke by Week 4, Mike Evans hurts his Achilles, and now he can't afford a replacement. The audacity. The NERVE.

Three championship games. Three losses. 2020, 2022, 2024. You know what that tells me? It tells me this man doesn't know how to close! He's the guy who gets to the altar and forgets the ring! Every other year! And here we are, 2026, an even year again, and he's 4-2. I've seen this movie. I KNOW how it ends. And it ends with him crying into a runner-up trophy shaped like Kalif Raymond's face!

columns.title: ChuckJ10, I'm begging you. Do SOMETHING.
columns.dek: Last year's top seed has the fewest points in the league and the trade button is collecting dust.
body: I've watched the film on ChuckJ10. All six weeks of it. And I need everybody to understand what I saw, because it was soft. Last year? 11-3. Number one seed. Walking around like he owned the place. This year? Fewest points in the league. Season low. Biggest blowout loss. Closest loss. Man collected the whole set of pain in six weeks.
And you know what's crazy? He's got Justin Jefferson AND Malik Nabers on that roster. Two WR1s! You can't be this bad with two WR1s, it's not physically possible, and yet here we are! Here we ARE!

Caleb Williams is the QB19. ChuckJ10, in my day, if you weren't producing, Coach sat you down and found somebody who would. Ivefallenandicantgetup has Lamar Jackson sitting on his bench like a spare tire. Pick up the phone! Send an offer! Send ANYTHING! Right now you're playing prevent defense in the first quarter, and that's the softest thing a man can do.

This week he's a 16.5-point dog against Stroud of Turin. Win that, and maybe I come back next week and say something nice. Lose it, and I'm buying you a toilet bowl trophy myself. I'll engrave it. 'ChuckJ10: Was Here.'

columns.title: Klozoff's 5 Moves to Win Your League (Guaranteed)
columns.dek: I've been doing this a long time. Not well, but a long time.
body: 1. SELL JAXON SMITH-NJIGBA. dstafford, listen to me. He's the WR1 by 34 points. That's called a peak, and what comes after a peak? A valley. Trade him right now for two backup tight ends and a defense on bye. That's called diversifying your portfolio.
2. FatMikeR, DO NOT SPEND THAT $200 FAAB. That money is compounding. By Week 17 it could be worth $210, maybe $215. Your receivers are hurt? So is the economy. Hold the line.

3. Bench Josh Allen permanently. krunkdd, he's on bye this week and the Bills will survive without him, which proves he's replaceable. Lamar's right there. Start the hot hand. Lamar hasn't played in two weeks, which means he's fully rested and his hands are hot from not being used.

4. Lawrence of a Labia should start Jacoby Brissett every week from now on, even when Trevor Lawrence is back. Two quarterbacks named after the same thing? No, wait, that's not it. I don't remember why. Just do it.

5. Everybody pick up a kicker. I know this league doesn't have a kicker slot. That's exactly why nobody's doing it. Zig when they zag. Corner the market. When the commissioner adds a kicker slot in Week 14, you'll own all of them and I'll accept your thanks in the form of a venmo.

columns.title: My Model Has Solved Fantasy Football
columns.dek: After 400 hours in Excel, the data has spoken. It said some things. I wrote them down.
body: Let's start with the most predictive stat in fantasy football: punctuation. Teams with punctuation in their name (NjigbaR Please!, Breece'sBurdenDeflowered) are a combined 8-4. Teams without punctuation are 28-32. The exclamation point alone is worth roughly 1.4 wins per season. I've adjusted for strength of schedule. I don't know how, but I did.

Next: capital letters. MY DAD IS DEAD is the only team name in all caps and it is 1-5. That's a 16.7% win rate. My model projects that for every additional capital letter, a team loses 0.04 games. I recommend everyone switch to lowercase immediately. 'bijan is your daddy' would be 4-2 right now. I've run it 10,000 times.

The model also flagged Llamageddon. dcrabb leads the league in points left on the bench (138.4). My conclusion: his bench is the best team in the league. I recommend he start his bench and bench his starters. My model gives this a 91% chance of working, with a margin of error of 91%.
Finally, my model predicts the Week 7 winners with 100% confidence: whichever team scores more points. I'll be taking questions. Please don't.

exits.t: Watson's camp is reportedly uneasy with the quarterback situation. Br0phy rosters three QBs and still started the wrong one in Week 4.
Requested a trade after sitting on the bench for 27.7 points while his manager started a tight end who scored zero. Would settle for a manager who reads box scores.
Signed for $100. Zero starts. Sources say he's asking why he was bought just to sit, and whether this is a fantasy team or a storage unit.
Both have quietly asked to be moved out of the lowest-scoring locker room in the league. Their agents describe the culture as 'ChuckJ10.'
Cost $125 in Week 1 and hasn't started a game. Reportedly feels like the expensive throw pillow nobody's allowed to touch.
The RB1 overall has reportedly asked team doctors whether the Achane in the Membrane curse is contagious. They didn't know. Nobody does.

commish.title: The Commissioner's Office
commish.dek: The two men who run this league, collect your money, and answer to no one.

body: The winningest manager in Addicks history, the man who built this website, and somehow still without a ring. Bill_Buttlicker has 65 regular-season wins, six playoff trips in seven years, and a 2019 final he'd rather not talk about.
He runs the league, sets the payouts, and writes the newsletter that roasts all of you. He also scored 214.54 in 2019 Week 5, the second-highest week in league history. Respect the office.

The first champion in Addicks history. ChuckJ10 won it all in 2019, made the final again in 2021, and went 11-3 as last year's top seed. He has the ring the commissioner doesn't, and he's the second-winningest manager of all time.
This season has been a different story, and the co-commish has been on the receiving end of more than a few A.N.A.L. headlines. Fortunately, he has the authority to overturn none of them.

rulings: Bill_Buttlicker scored 104.44. FatMikeR's 101.92 was closest, so Bijan is your daddy takes the pot.
